items.name: product-card
items.title: Product Card
items.description: Catalogue tile with badges, compare-at pricing, colour swatches that swap the image, rating, a keyboard-reachable quick-add, and a wishlist heart under the badge (your shadcn Toggle, optimistic). Colours can be hidden for products that don't come in any. Compound: use it as one tag, or recompose it from ProductCardMedia, ProductCardBody and their parts via useProductCard().
items.author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>
